newsitem.title: USA: Four new members appointed to Calif. coastal panel.
newsitem.headline: Four new members appointed to Calif. coastal panel.

text.p: California state Assembly Speaker Cruz Bustamante on Monday announced the appointment of four new members to the California Coastal Commission.
The four new members are Monterey County Supervisor Dave Potter, San Diego City Council member Christine Kehoe, Pedro Nava of Santa Barbara, and Andrea Tuttle of Arcata.
Bustamante also announced that he will confirm four alternates to the four regular Coastal Commission members.
"These new appointees are wholly committed to protecting the coast and to maintaining a balanced approach to growth, development and public access," Bustamante said.
The commission, established by voter initiative in 1972, plans and regulates development along California's coast. The commission has 16 members, 12 voting and four non-voting.
